title: Three Lānaʻi Planning Commission seats opening
summary: The Lānaʻi Planning Commission chair asked that three seats opening March 31, 2027 be listed in the director's report. Applications for the vacancies are due December 31, 2026.

timeline.text: The chair asked that three commission seats opening March 31, 2027 be listed in the director's report.
The chair said that for terms ending in March 2027, the nominations board must get applications by December 31st.
